blurb: Emerald Necklace Marina offers in-water dockage, rack dockage, kayak locker storage, and winter and summer boat and trailer storage. The marina has a full-service ship store with marine supplies, live bait, fishing tackle, and snacks. It also provides fuel dock services with non-ethanol marine grade fuel and a free pump-out station.
